name: stealth-raider
description: Covert-ops privacy kit for Chrome: spoof fingerprint, location & IP, incognito raids, self-destruct traces.

scripts.check: node --check src/content/inject-loader.js && node --check src/content/fingerprint-spoof.js && for f in src/lib/*.js src/background/*.js src/popup/*.js src/options/*.js; do node --input-type=module --check < "$f"; done
scripts.zip: rm -f stealth-raider.zip && zip -r -FS stealth-raider.zip manifest.json src -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.theme:zip: rm -f stealth-raider-theme.zip && cd theme && zip -r -FS ../stealth-raider-theme.zip manifest.json images -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.zip:all: npm run zip && npm run theme:zip
